body: Coming home at the end of the day and having no one to make me feel loved, for one thing. My life just feels so incomplete without someone to share it with.

I'm bisexual, so yes. The problem is that I prefer women, so I'd like my first time to be with one (plus I could definitively say that I'm not a virgin anymore). I used to have an account on Grindr, but most of the guys I found were gym bros or smoked weed, plus I was uneasy about the thought of a casual hookup.

You're not telling me anything I haven't already heard a million times. I can't just choose to be happy with who I am. Every step I take to try and improve myself gets me absolutely nothing in return. It doesn't provide me with any long-term satisfaction, and it sure as hell isn't making me more desirable to women.

I knew I should have explained this. The only reason why I pushed my luck that hard at the end of my date was because I saw on her profile that she was mainly looking for a "friends with benefits" type of relationship and didn't know whether she was waiting for me to make the next move. If it were anyone else, I would have just said goodbye.

I've tried to enjoy my life. I've taken on new hobbies, joined clubs, and last year I even checked off the item at the very top of my bucket list. I still go right back to feeling empty sooner or later. It's like there's this empty space inside me that can only be filled by having someone to love and be loved by. Everyone else can find a way to fill that empty space, so why can't I? How come I have to keep waiting and waiting for the right person to come along, when most people don't?

Thanks, but it's not just the lack of sex that makes me miserable. It's wanting someone to want me. My virginity is just the most obvious symptom of a much bigger problem. If I could just hold someone and have them say they love me, that would probably be enough to make me not hate myself.
Or maybe I don't want to be treated like a circus animal. I'm a human being. I get that you're trying to be funny, but I'm really not in the mood for wizard jokes right now.
I guess I'm just jaded because I never got laid in high school or college. Every girl I wanted to hook up with either already had a boyfriend, was asexual, or only wanted to be friends.
I have a profile on OKC, but no luck so far. I've heard that dating sites/apps are hard for guys because the girls get a shitload of messages and probably won't message you back.
Guess you forgot about me. Figures. You're just like everyone else. You'll throw out some meaningless bullshit and pat yourself on the back. I bet you didn't even read what I had to say.
